profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based AI video platform founded in 2017. The company describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business and states that its platform is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to communicate, train, and upskill teams. Its core product allows users to create studio-quality videos using AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages without cameras, microphones, actors, or studios, and the company claims users can save up to 90% of time and cost on video production.

The platform's features include an AI avatar generator, AI voice generation and cloning, a video editor, a screen recorder, PowerPoint-to-video conversion, and interactive avatars. A free plan is available that includes 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and AI voices across 160+ languages. The platform integrates with Learning Management Systems and includes analytics such as views, drop-offs, and completion rates. Synthesia states it is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, and notes that its content is labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The site's held facts list Synthesia's product under the Video Generation and Editing category, with a noted risk around AI avatars and likeness or consent considerations. No litigation or regulatory filings are recorded against the company in the held facts.
